mustFix.trigger: Open map at headA; clean background refresh installs project headB; old SVG remains; click old cached edge and save.
mustFix.finding: refresh replaces state.project and calls renderLists→DirectoryEditor.update, which does not redraw the open map. edgeForm copies the drawn old edge but takes current project head/revision. This can submit old headA fields as a new edit based on headB, defeating normal stale-base conflict protection.
mustFix.minimumFix: Bind edge editing to the map/read head. Redraw open map on project head change without resetting forms; also reject/refresh an edge click whose map head no longer equals current head, or retain its actual read base for normal conflict handling.

otherStaticFindings.finding: Pick<GitHubRepository,library|read> preserves generic native reads; section/manifest IDs are numeric; no static mismatch identified. No build/type compiler run.

Each promise mutates its own entry object; map is keyed by section and cleared on head changes. Detached old promises cannot install data into the new map. updated only redraws matching section/head and open dialog. This does not cover already drawn head change B1.
error remains visible; focus/reselect retries an error entry; callback graph(false) does not itself retry indefinitely.
sources=[] is valid for storyDirectory; coverage lists missingSceneIds and UI says known0 plus restoration-needed, not confirmed original absence.

Actual manifest currently has no deleted=true edges. Existing storyDirectory nativeTarget replacement and row.deleted branch are reused unchanged, preserving manual identity/deletion behavior by static source inspection.
Read completion calls graph only; does not replace state.project or call form/choose/clean/clearEditor. Existing form dirtiness and base remain intact until B1 edge-open case.

edgeList still consumes current project.directory.edges, so a selected off-scope scene can show graph lines while right-hand list says no recorded successor. Optional follow-up: share the detached same-head scoped list; map-line editing itself remains available.

Native-only Promise.all has no explicit worker pool. Current manifest maximum imported sources per section is18 (section1002), so this is not identified as an actual limit failure; bounded concurrency would match existing reader policy.
